operation.description: Enables dependency alerts and the dependency graph for a repository. The authenticated user must have admin access to the repository. For more information, see "[About security alerts for vulnerable dependencies](https://docs.github.com/articles/about-security-alerts-for-vulnerable-dependencies)".

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo
